requirements.text: The pipeline shall ingest an MLDS scene and preserve stable object identities.
The pipeline shall derive room semantics grounded in existing MLDS objects.
The pipeline shall synthesize backend-compatible spatial agent roles.
Every generated agent knowledge tag shall be covered by materialized knowledge.
Every generated agent shall be placed inside the room without obstacle overlap.
The generated behavior shall be traceable from requirements to runtime actions and validation cases.

useCases.name: Generate and use spatially grounded multi-agent guide

scenarios.description: Main scenario for generating and using a spatially grounded multi-agent room guide.

steps.text: Provide an MLDS file as case-study input.
Load and normalize the MLDS scene.
Derive semantic zones, visitor goals and interaction topics.
Generate spatially grounded agent roles and handoff rules.
Generate materialized knowledge entries for all agent knowledge tags.
Place generated agents inside the room near their responsibilities.
Assemble and validate the FunctionalMLDS trace instance.
Materialize the Interactive Agents project files.
Set up an Interactive Agents runtime session.
Ask a room-related question to an agent.
Answer the visitor question using grounded room knowledge.
Optionally hand off to the responsible specialist agent.

stateAssertions.expression: Normalized MLDS scene is valid and object IDs are unique.
Scene semantics are grounded in existing object IDs.
Generated agents have valid zones, objects, knowledge tags and handoff targets.
Every agent knowledge tag has at least one materialized knowledge entry.
Every generated agent has a valid room position and forward vector.
FunctionalMLDS instance satisfies all core invariants.
Interactive Agents project files are present and backend-readable.
Interactive Agents backend setup returns a valid session with all agents.
A visitor question is answered using room-grounded agent knowledge.
A specialist handoff targets an existing responsible agent when needed.
